  refine Finite.of_injective (fun ⟨⟨i₁, i₂, i₃⟩, (hi : i₁ + i₂ + i₃ = n)⟩ =>
    (⟨⟨i₁, by omega⟩, ⟨i₂, by omega⟩, ⟨i₃, by omega⟩⟩ :
      Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 1))) ?_
  rintro ⟨⟨_, _, _⟩, _⟩ ⟨⟨_, _, _⟩, _⟩ h
  simpa using h
